## Verdict

wrong

## Bearer

RecordedRaceListenerService — app-phone/src/main/java/com/mgilli/hyroxtracker/sync/RecordedRaceListenerService.kt

## Trigger

`onMessageReceived`, called by Play Services on its own binder thread — observed

## Today

`RecordedRaceListenerService` holds `serviceScope = CoroutineScope(SupervisorJob() + Dispatchers.IO)`
but only uses it to send the acknowledgement: `serviceScope.launch { ackTransport.send(...) }`.
`raceRepository.saveRecordedRace(...)` — a synchronous Room write, confirmed by its signature
`fun saveRecordedRace(...): Result<Race>` in `RaceRepository` (core-domain) and its implementation
in `RaceRepositoryImpl` (core-data) — runs directly inside `onMessageReceived`, before any `launch`,
so it executes on whatever thread Play Services handed the callback, not on `serviceScope`.

A second, independent case of the same pattern: `RecordedRaceAckListenerService` on the watch
(app-wear/src/main/java/com/mgilli/app_wear/sync/RecordedRaceAckListenerService.kt) declares no
`CoroutineScope` at all. Its `onMessageReceived` calls
`recordedRaceSyncService.acknowledge(raceId)` — also synchronous, `fun acknowledge(raceId: Long): Result<Unit>`
in `RecordedRaceSyncService` (core-domain), which delegates to
`raceRecordingRepository.eraseRecorded(raceId)` — straight on the Play Services callback thread.

## Expected

`onMessageReceived`, on both services, dispatches its database write onto the IO scope instead of
running it inline. On the phone, `RecordedRaceListenerService` wraps `raceRepository.saveRecordedRace(...)`
in `serviceScope.launch { }` (or an equivalent structured launch), and only sends the acknowledgement
once that write completes and succeeds on that same scope — the ordering `onMessageReceived` relies on
today (ack only after a successful save) must be preserved inside the coroutine.

Second gap — `RecordedRaceAckListenerService` has no `CoroutineScope` at all, so there is nothing to
dispatch `recordedRaceSyncService.acknowledge(raceId)` onto. It needs one created on the same terms as
the phone's (`CoroutineScope(SupervisorJob() + Dispatchers.IO)`), then `acknowledge` is launched on it
instead of being called inline in `onMessageReceived`.
